units.name: Management Science
units.school: Doy B. Henley School of Management and Business Technology
units.evidence: Official school faculty directory groups Management Science separately from management, law, international business and marketing. This area includes Ravi Kathuria (operations strategy, supply chain), Charu Sinha (stochastic operations modelling) and Parisa Eimanzadeh (operations research). School is within Argyros College of Business and Economics; no standalone department claimed.

decisions.reason: Official Management Science faculty area verified under current Henley school; not incorrectly labeled a department.

sources.note: Full school name, university footer, faculty area structure and substantive operations research remit.
Complete school/college inventory identifies engineering branch.
Dale E. and Sarah Ann Fowler School of Engineering verified.
Five undergraduate engineering/computing programs read: computer engineering/science, data science, electrical and software engineering; no industrial-engineering unit established.
Graduate branch is Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, not industrial engineering.
